name: Divorce Logistics
description: Produces structured logistics checklists for the practical aspects of divorce including financial separation steps, legal document needs, housing transition planning, and co-parenting logistics frameworks. Focuses exclusively on the organizational and administrative tasks that need to happen during a divorce, not relationship assessment or emotional counseling. Use when the user asks about the practical steps of going through a divorce, separating finances, or organizing co-parenting logistics. Do NOT use for advice on whether to divorce, relationship counseling, custody legal strategy, or emotional processing of divorce.
